Definition: genitive case of G4771; of thee, thy:--X home, thee, thine (own), thou, thy.
BiblicalUsage: This is the genitive of thou, the of thee and thy that marks what belongs to the person spoken to. Paul is glad to answer before thee, king Agrippa; he has remembrance of thee in his prayers night and day; and the men lying in wait look for a promise from thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word carries the weight of a relationship: before thee, remembrance of thee, a promise from thee.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
